narrative.overview: One canvas sky is fixed behind the whole guide. The 310 tactics are its stars, grouped into ten constellations, and the camera moves with the reader. Everything else is quiet type laid over that sky, with Apple-like restraint: no cards, no boxes, hairlines, space and scale do the work.
keyCharacteristics: Dark night-sky default with a light twilight theme.
Astra display over Public Sans reading.
Gold for stars, links and active marks; ember for safety only.
Typographic list rows between hairlines replace cards.
Calm mode and reduced motion stop all motion.

rules.name: The Star Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where something is a star, a link or an active mark. It never fills a surface or decorates.

rules.name: The Alpha Ladder Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy is one off-white at 100, .70 and .47 alpha; do not introduce new greys.

rules.name: The 24px Floor Rule
rules.body: Astra is used at 24px and up. Below that, set Public Sans.

rules.name: The Plain Script Rule
rules.body: Anything the reader might say aloud or act on is Public Sans.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from hairlines, blur and the sky, never from box-shadow.

rules.name: The Glass Only Where Floating Rule
rules.body: A surface is glass only if it hovers over the canvas or scrolling content.

dos: Do build structure with 1px hairlines (.14 alpha), space and type scale.
Do keep gold for stars, links and active marks; ember for safety only.
Do set Astra at 24px and up, Public Sans everywhere else and for all scripts.
Do let the sky and the camera carry orientation, and keep content visible with Calm mode and reduced motion.
Do keep pills for controls and 44px minimum touch targets.
donts: Don't wrap content in cards or boxed panels; use list rows between hairlines.
Don't introduce a second accent or tint a surface gold.
Don't hide content behind animation or let a reveal delay help.
